invariants.name: Identity Preservation
invariants.definition: A source record must remain associated with the exact same logical transaction and customer entity identifier throughout parsing, transformation, and storage.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Deterministic UUID / message ID tracking and customer_id / account_id propagation in NormalizedTransaction and TransactionPredictRequest.

invariants.name: Tenant Ownership
invariants.definition: A record belonging to institution/tenant A must not become owned by, cached for, or visible as tenant B through ingestion-state corruption or key collision.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Tenant-namespaced Redis keys in IdempotencyService ('idem:{tenant}:{hash}') and CloudEvents ('{tenant}:{key}').

invariants.name: Schema Fidelity
invariants.definition: Accepted records must strictly satisfy the canonical schema expected downstream, rejecting malformed structures and non-finite floats.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Pydantic v2 strict models, XSD schema validation, and field validators enforcing math.isfinite.

invariants.name: Value Fidelity
invariants.definition: Fields must not silently change meaning or invert relationships during parsing, normalization, serialization, or persistence.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Strict directed debtor -> creditor edge construction and unswapped account mapping.

invariants.name: Unit Fidelity
invariants.definition: Monetary amounts, velocities, and risk scores must preserve explicitly defined units without binary precision loss or unauthorized scale changes.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Standard float bounds with ge=0.0 / le=1.0 and Decimal representations in CloudEvents.

invariants.name: Temporal Fidelity
invariants.definition: Source event time, system ingestion time, and processing time must not be silently conflated or overwritten.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Explicit parsing of CreDtTm, value_timestamp, and creationDate, with fallback to now(UTC) only when absent.

invariants.name: Ordering Truth
invariants.definition: Any ordering guarantee relied upon downstream must actually be enforced via sequential offsets or explicitly declared absent.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Topic partition sequential offsets in Kafka and sliding window timestamp sorting.

invariants.name: Idempotency
invariants.definition: Reprocessing the same logical event must produce deterministic duplicate acknowledgment without side-effects or state duplication.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: IdempotencyService acquire-complete protocol and FeatureStoreService transaction_id deduplication.

invariants.name: Retry Safety
invariants.definition: Retrying an unacknowledged message or API call must not duplicate balances, velocities, or cases.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Atomic reservation in IdempotencyEngine and 24-hour response caching.

invariants.name: Failure Truth
invariants.definition: Malformed or unavailable data must fail closed or route to a dead-letter queue rather than fabricating valid mock data.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: DLQ isolation on CloudEvent parsing failures and SIEM parse failure audit logging.

invariants.name: Serialization Fidelity
invariants.definition: Encode/decode and persistence round trips must preserve the canonical record semantics identically.

invariants.name: Partition Fidelity
invariants.definition: Data assigned to a bank or tenant partition must belong strictly to the intended partition without cross-client leakage.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: enforce_tenant_isolation checks at Presentation boundaries and bank_id filesystem partitioning.

invariants.name: Missing-Value Truth
invariants.definition: Missing data must remain distinguishable from genuine zero or default values where business semantics differ.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Explicit None checks (payload.get('amount') is not None) preventing 0.0 from fabricating defaults.

invariants.name: Provenance Fidelity
invariants.definition: Downstream records must remain traceable to their originating institution and source message reference.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: NormalizedTransaction.bank_id, CloudEvent.source, and FinCEN SAR audit hashes.

invariants.name: Concurrency Safety
invariants.definition: Concurrent ingestion must not corrupt shared state, race check-then-act locks, or duplicate records.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Thread locks in IdempotencyEngine, atomic set(..., nx=True) in Redis, and RLock in StreamingGraphService.

invariants.name: Replay Fidelity
invariants.definition: Replaying historical events must follow defined event-time semantics without mutating current real-time state.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Preserved event timestamps and timestamp-based sliding window filtering.

invariants.name: Downstream Contract Fidelity
invariants.definition: Graph, model, FL, and explainability layers must receive the exact typed representation their contracts require.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Preprocessed NumPy/PyTorch tensor dimensional normalization and typed DTO conversion.
